svg.title: Angra 2 class PWR, 1350 MWe (CH15) - Electrical one-line diagram

g.text: Safety trains: 4 x 50 pct (any 2 of 4 carry the safety load: N+2). Diesels system 1: 4 x 5.4 MW / 6.6 MVA at 10 kV; system 2 (bunkered emergency feed): 4 x 0.86 MW at 0.4 kV.
House load 70 MW (1350 - 1280) = 82.35 MVA at pf 0.85 <= 2 x 50 MVA unit auxiliary, <= 90 MVA standby. Values marked ASSUMED in docs/CH15_REFERENCE.md: MT, UAT, SST, LT, GCB.
